svg.aria-label: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star as a single-note tab
svg.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star as a single-note tab
svg.text: "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star": C major, 4/4, 72 beats a minute
Numbered notation, tab, then lyric; one cell is one beat, and "·" means hold the previous note
String 5 fret 3 is low do; string 2 fret 1 is high do. The tune only uses that middle stretch
Fingers: fret 3 = ring, fret 2 = middle, 0 = open. Right hand: thumb down or pick down, both fine
